facts.claim_en: In Arizona, a personal representative is a fiduciary who must meet the standards of care that apply to trustees.
facts.claim_es: En Arizona, el representante personal es un fiduciario que debe cumplir las normas de cuidado que se aplican a los fideicomisarios.
facts.quote: a personal representative is a fiduciary who shall observe the standards of care applicable to trustees

facts.claim_en: In Arizona, the personal representative must tell the heirs and beneficiaries about the appointment within thirty days.

facts.claim_es: En Arizona, el representante personal debe preparar un inventario de la herencia dentro de noventa días después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: Within ninety days after his appointment, a personal representative, who is not a special administrator or a successor to another representative who has previously discharged this duty, shall prepare an inventory

facts.claim_en: In Idaho, a personal representative is a fiduciary held to the standards of care that apply to trustees.
facts.claim_es: En Idaho, el representante personal es un fiduciario sujeto a las normas de cuidado de los fideicomisarios.

facts.claim_es: En Idaho, el representante personal debe preparar un inventario dentro de 3 meses después del nombramiento.

facts.claim_en: In Idaho, the personal representative sends a copy of the inventory to interested persons who ask, and may file the original with the court.
facts.claim_es: En Idaho, el representante personal envía copia del inventario a las personas interesadas que la pidan, y puede presentar el original ante el tribunal.
facts.quote: The personal representative shall send a copy of the inventory to interested persons who request it, and he may file the original of the inventory with the court.

facts.claim_es: En Minnesota, el representante personal envía o entrega el inventario al cónyuge sobreviviente y a todos los beneficiarios residuales.
facts.quote: The personal representative shall mail or deliver a copy of the inventory to the surviving spouse, if there be one, to all residuary distributees

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, a personal representative is a fiduciary who must follow the prudent investor rule.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, el representante personal es un fiduciario que debe seguir la regla del inversionista prudente.
facts.quote: A personal representative is a fiduciary who shall comply with the prudent investor rule

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, the personal representative must prepare and file an inventory within three months after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, el representante personal debe preparar y presentar un inventario dentro de tres meses después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: Within three months after appointment, a personal representative, who is not a special administrator or a successor to another representative who has previously discharged this duty, shall prepare and file an inventory

facts.claim_en: In Nebraska, the original inventory is filed with the court and a copy goes to interested persons who ask.
facts.claim_es: En Nebraska, el inventario original se presenta ante el tribunal y se envía copia a los interesados que la pidan.
facts.quote: The personal representative shall send a copy of the inventory to interested persons who request it and shall file the original of the inventory with the court.

facts.claim_en: In Montana, the personal representative must prepare an inventory within 9 months after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En Montana, el representante personal debe preparar un inventario dentro de 9 meses después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: Within 9 months after appointment, a personal representative who is not a special administrator or a successor to another representative who has previously discharged this duty shall prepare an inventory

facts.claim_en: In Montana, the inventory must state the fair market value of the person's interest in every listed item.
facts.claim_es: En Montana, el inventario debe indicar el valor de mercado de la participación de la persona en cada bien.
facts.quote: The inventory must include a statement of the fair market value of the decedent's interest in every item listed in the inventory.

facts.claim_en: In Montana, a personal representative is a fiduciary held to the standards of care for trustees under Montana law.
facts.claim_es: En Montana, el representante personal es un fiduciario sujeto a las normas de cuidado de los fideicomisarios según la ley de Montana.
facts.quote: A personal representative is a fiduciary who shall observe the standards of care applicable to trustees under the laws of the state of Montana.

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, the executor or administrator must file an inventory with the probate court within three months after appointment, unless the court extends the time.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, el albacea o administrador debe presentar un inventario ante el tribunal testamentario dentro de tres meses después del nombramiento, salvo que el tribunal extienda el plazo.
facts.quote: Within three months after the date of the executor's or administrator's appointment, unless the probate court grants an extension of time for good cause shown, the executor or administrator shall file with the cou

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, the inventory lists values as of the date of death.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, el inventario indica los valores a la fecha de la muerte.
facts.quote: The inventory shall set forth values as of the date of death of the decedent.

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, an executor or administrator who distributes estate assets within three months after the death can be personally liable to certain creditors.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, el albacea o administrador que reparte bienes de la herencia dentro de tres meses después de la muerte puede responder personalmente ante ciertos acreedores.
facts.quote: If the executor or administrator distributes any part of the assets of the estate within three months after the death of the decedent, the executor or administrator shall be personally liable

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, the estate representative must file a verified inventory in court within 60 days after letters are issued.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, el representante de la herencia debe presentar un inventario verificado ante el tribunal dentro de 60 días después de emitidas las cartas.
facts.quote: Within 60 days after the issuance of his letters the representative of the estate of a decedent or ward shall file in the court a verified inventory

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, property found after the inventory is filed must be added in a supplemental inventory within 60 days.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, los bienes encontrados después del inventario deben agregarse en un inventario suplementario dentro de 60 días.
facts.quote: he shall file a supplemental inventory thereof within 60 days after it comes to his knowledge

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, the representative must give an account within 60 days after the first 12 months from the issuance of letters.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, el representante debe rendir cuentas dentro de 60 días después de los primeros 12 meses desde la emisión de las cartas.
facts.quote: within 60 days after the expiration of 12 months after the issuance of letters

facts.claim_en: In Iowa, the personal representative must file a report and inventory with the clerk within ninety days after qualifying.
facts.claim_es: En Iowa, el representante personal debe presentar un informe e inventario ante el secretario dentro de noventa días después de habilitarse.
facts.quote: Within ninety days after qualification by the personal representative, unless a longer time is granted by the court, the personal representative shall file with the clerk a report and inventory

facts.claim_en: In Iowa, the report and inventory are verified or affirmed under penalty of perjury.
facts.claim_es: En Iowa, el informe y el inventario se verifican o afirman bajo pena de perjurio.
facts.quote: The report and inventory shall be verified or affirmed under penalty of perjury.

facts.claim_en: In Iowa, an action to set aside the probate of a will must be brought within four months after the second published notice or one month after mailing, whichever is later.
facts.claim_es: En Iowa, una acción para anular la validación de un testamento debe presentarse dentro de cuatro meses después del segundo aviso publicado o un mes después del envío, lo que ocurra más tarde.
facts.quote: must be brought within the later to occur of four months from the date of the second publication of the notice or one month from the date of maili

facts.claim_en: In Virginia, the personal representative must file an inventory with the commissioner of accounts within four months after qualifying.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia, el representante personal debe presentar un inventario ante el comisionado de cuentas (commissioner of accounts) dentro de cuatro meses después de habilitarse.
facts.quote: Every personal representative or curator shall, within four months after the date of the order conferring his authority, return to the commissioner of accounts an inventory

facts.claim_en: In Virginia, the fiduciary accounts before the commissioner of accounts where they qualified.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia, el fiduciario rinde cuentas ante el comisionado de cuentas de la jurisdicción donde se habilitó.
facts.quote: Every fiduciary referred to in this part shall account before the commissioner of accounts of the jurisdiction wherein he qualified

facts.claim_en: In Virginia, beneficiaries who ask in writing must be mailed copies of the inventory and accounts, including a copy of the will.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia, a los beneficiarios que lo pidan por escrito se les deben enviar copias del inventario y las cuentas, incluida una copia del testamento.
facts.quote: they must mail copies of these documents (not including any supporting vouchers, but including a copy of the decedent's will) to you

facts.claim_en: In DC, the personal representative must prepare a verified inventory within 3 months of appointment.
facts.claim_es: En DC, el representante personal debe preparar un inventario verificado dentro de 3 meses del nombramiento.
facts.quote: a personal representative shall, within 3 months of appointment, prepare a verified inventory of property owned by the decedent at the time of his death

facts.claim_en: In DC, the personal representative must publish a notice of the appointment within 20 days after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En DC, el representante personal debe publicar un aviso de su nombramiento dentro de 20 días después de ser nombrado.
facts.quote: Within 20 days after appointment, the personal representative shall, unless notice has already been given under this subsection, publish a notice of the appointment

facts.claim_en: In DC, the personal representative must also send notice by registered or certified mail within 20 days after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En DC, el representante personal también debe enviar aviso por correo registrado o certificado dentro de 20 días después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: Not later than 20 days after appointment, a personal representative (except when notice under this subsection has already been given) shall send, by registered or certified m

facts.claim_en: In South Carolina, the personal representative files the inventory and appraisement with the court within ninety days after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Sur, el representante personal presenta el inventario y avalúo ante el tribunal dentro de noventa días después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: Within ninety days after his appointment he shall file with the court the inventory and appraisement

facts.claim_en: In South Carolina, a personal representative who does not post a required bond within thirty days after notice can be removed.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Sur, el representante personal que no deposita la fianza requerida dentro de treinta días después del aviso puede ser removido.
facts.quote: Failure of the personal representative to meet a requirement of bond by giving suitable bond within thirty days after receipt of notice is cause for his removal

facts.claim_en: In South Carolina, after an informal probate is granted, the applicant must give written information about it to the heirs and beneficiaries within thirty days.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Sur, después de concederse una sucesión informal, el solicitante debe informar por escrito a los herederos y beneficiarios dentro de treinta días.
facts.quote: within thirty days thereafter the applicant shall give written information of the probate to the heirs

facts.claim_en: In Florida, an interested person served with the personal representative's notice may ask for the representative's removal within 30 days.
facts.claim_es: En Florida, una persona interesada que recibe el aviso del representante personal puede pedir su remoción dentro de 30 días.
facts.quote: may file a petition requesting the personal representative's removal within 30 days after the date on which such notice is served

facts.claim_en: In Florida, the personal representative files a safe-deposit box inventory with the court within 10 days after the box is opened.
facts.claim_es: En Florida, el representante personal presenta ante el tribunal el inventario de la caja de seguridad dentro de 10 días después de abrirla.
facts.quote: The personal representative shall file the safe-deposit box inventory, together with a copy of the box entry record from a date which is 6 months prior to the date of death to the date of inventory, with the court within 10 days after the box is opened.

facts.claim_en: In Florida, the personal representative must answer certain written requests from interested persons within 14 days.
facts.claim_es: En Florida, el representante personal debe responder ciertas solicitudes escritas de personas interesadas dentro de 14 días.
facts.quote: Within 14 days after receipt of the written request of any interested person, the personal representative shall deliver to the requesting person

facts.claim_en: In Oregon, within 30 days after appointment the personal representative files proof that the required information was delivered or mailed to heirs and beneficiaries.
facts.claim_es: En Oregón, dentro de 30 días después del nombramiento el representante personal presenta constancia de que entregó o envió la información requerida a herederos y beneficiarios.
facts.quote: Within 30 days after the date of appointment a personal representative shall cause to be filed in the estate proceeding proof of the delivery or mailing required by this section

facts.claim_en: In Oregon, if new assets turn up and no bond was required, the personal representative must act within 30 days after filing the inventory.
facts.claim_es: En Oregón, si aparecen bienes nuevos y no se exigió fianza, el representante personal debe actuar dentro de 30 días después de presentar el inventario.
facts.quote: the personal representative shall, within 30 days after filing the inventory or supplementa

facts.claim_en: In Oregon, a special administrator must file an account and hand the assets to the personal representative within 30 days after letters are issued.
facts.claim_es: En Oregón, el administrador especial debe rendir cuentas y entregar los bienes al representante personal dentro de 30 días después de emitidas las cartas.
facts.quote: Within 30 days after the issuance of letters testamentary or letters of administration to a personal representative, the special administrator shall make and file an account

facts.claim_en: In Nevada, every personal representative must file an inventory and appraisement of the estate's assets with the clerk.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, todo representante personal debe presentar ante el secretario un inventario y avalúo de los bienes de la herencia.
facts.quote: every personal representative shall prepare and file with the clerk a true inventory and appraisement or record of value of all the assets of the decedent

facts.claim_en: In Nevada, the personal representative mails a copy of the inventory to interested heirs within 10 days after filing it, unless they already got a list of assets.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, el representante personal envía copia del inventario a los herederos interesados dentro de 10 días después de presentarlo, salvo que ya hayan recibido una lista de bienes.
facts.quote: within 10 days after filing the inventory with the clerk, shall mail a copy to all the interested heirs

facts.claim_en: In Nevada, property found later goes on a supplementary inventory filed within 20 days after it is discovered.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, los bienes encontrados después se incluyen en un inventario suplementario presentado dentro de 20 días después de descubrirse.
facts.quote: the personal representative shall file a supplementary inventory of that property within 20 days after its discovery

facts.claim_en: In Maryland, the personal representative must prepare and file an inventory within 3 months after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En Maryland, el representante personal debe preparar y presentar un inventario dentro de 3 meses después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: within 3 months after the appointment of a personal representative, the personal representative shall prepare and file an inventory

facts.claim_en: In Maryland, the first account is due within 9 months from the personal representative's appointment.
facts.claim_es: En Maryland, la primera rendición de cuentas vence dentro de 9 meses desde el nombramiento del representante personal.
facts.quote: Within 9 months from the date of the appointment of the personal representative

facts.claim_en: In Maryland, later accounts are due every 6 months until the final account is filed.
facts.claim_es: En Maryland, las cuentas siguientes vencen cada 6 meses hasta presentar la cuenta final.
facts.quote: Within 6 months after the account referred to in paragraph (1) of this subsection and within 6 months after each account thereafter until the filing of the final account

facts.claim_en: In Washington, the personal representative must make a sworn inventory and appraisement within three months after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, el representante personal debe hacer un inventario y avalúo bajo juramento dentro de tres meses después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: Within three months after appointment, unless a longer time shall be granted by the court, every personal representative shall make and verify by affidavit a true inventory and appraisement

facts.claim_en: In Washington, the inventory states each item's fair net value as of the date of death, after debts secured by the item.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, el inventario indica el valor neto justo de cada bien a la fecha de la muerte, después de las deudas garantizadas.
facts.quote: The personal representative shall determine the fair net value, as of the date of the decedent's death, of each item contained in the inventory after deducting the encumbrances

facts.claim_en: In Washington, the inventory does not have to be filed with the court, but heirs, beneficiaries and creditors with filed claims can request a copy.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, el inventario no tiene que presentarse ante el tribunal, pero herederos, beneficiarios y acreedores con reclamos presentados pueden pedir copia.
facts.quote: The inventory and appraisement may, but need not be, filed in the probate cause

facts.claim_en: In New Hampshire, the administrator must file an itemized inventory with the court within 90 days after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo Hampshire, el administrador debe presentar un inventario detallado ante el tribunal dentro de 90 días después del nombramiento.
facts.quote: within 90 days after the date of appointment, a full, true, and itemized inventory of all the estate of the decedent

facts.claim_en: In New Hampshire, an administrator who is 30 days late filing the inventory is in default.
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo Hampshire, el administrador que se atrasa 30 días en presentar el inventario queda en incumplimiento.
facts.quote: If an administrator fails to file an inventory within 30 days after the required filing date, the administrator is in default.

facts.claim_en: In New Hampshire, the clerk mails a default notice to the administrator within 10 days after the default.
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo Hampshire, el secretario envía al administrador un aviso de incumplimiento dentro de 10 días.
facts.quote: The clerk shall give notice of the default to the administrator by first class mail within 10 days after the default.

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, the personal representative must file an inventory no later than 6 months after appointment, unless the court changes the time.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, el representante personal debe presentar un inventario a más tardar 6 meses después del nombramiento, salvo que el tribunal cambie el plazo.
facts.quote: no later than 6 months after appointment unless the court has by order extended or shortened the time, shall file an inventory

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, the inventory shows which property is marital property, with values as of the date of death.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, el inventario indica qué bienes son gananciales, con valores a la fecha de la muerte.
facts.quote: what property is marital property

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, the personal representative must answer a request for the required statement within 5 days.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, el representante personal debe responder una solicitud de la declaración requerida dentro de 5 días.
facts.quote: the personal representative shall comply within 5 days after receipt of the request

facts.claim_en: Alabama's probate court handbook tells estate administrators that, as fiduciaries, they must not personally profit from the role.
facts.claim_es: El manual del tribunal testamentario de Alabama indica que el administrador, como fiduciario, no debe beneficiarse personalmente de su cargo.
facts.source_name: Mobile County Probate Court (Alabama), Administrator Handbook
facts.quote: You, as a fiduciary, must not personally profit by virtue of your position.

facts.claim_en: In Alabama, the administrator must handle the estate cautiously and discreetly and may not speculate with it.
facts.claim_es: En Alabama, el administrador debe manejar la herencia con cautela y discreción y no puede especular con ella.
facts.source_name: Mobile County Probate Court (Alabama), Administrator Handbook
facts.quote: You must be cautious and discreet in and about the handling of the Decedent's Estate, and you may not speculate.

facts.claim_en: In Alabama, a required bond premium is paid when the bond is signed and then every year until the estate is closed.
facts.claim_es: En Alabama, la prima de la fianza requerida se paga al firmarla y luego cada año hasta cerrar la herencia.
facts.source_name: Mobile County Probate Court (Alabama), Administrator Handbook
facts.quote: The bond premium must be paid when the bond is executed, and there will be a premium due each year thereafter until the Estate is closed.

facts.claim_en: In California, the personal representative must file an inventory and appraisal with the court within four months after Letters are first issued.
facts.claim_es: En California, el representante personal debe presentar ante el tribunal un inventario y avalúo dentro de cuatro meses después de emitidas las cartas.
facts.source_name: Judicial Council of California, form DE-147 (Duties and Liabilities of Personal Representative)
facts.quote: Within four months after Letters are first issued to you as personal representative, you must file with the court an inventory and appraisal of all the assets in the estate.

facts.claim_en: In California, the personal representative must mail a notice of administration to each known creditor within four months after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En California, el representante personal debe enviar un aviso de administración a cada acreedor conocido dentro de cuatro meses después del nombramiento.
facts.source_name: Judicial Council of California, form DE-147 (Duties and Liabilities of Personal Representative)
facts.quote: You must mail a notice of administration to each known creditor of the decedent within four months after your appointment as personal representative.

facts.claim_en: In California, if the person received Medi-Cal, the personal representative must notify the State Director of Health Services within 90 days after appointment.
facts.claim_es: En California, si la persona recibía Medi-Cal, el representante personal debe avisar al Director Estatal de Servicios de Salud dentro de 90 días después del nombramiento.
facts.source_name: Judicial Council of California, form DE-147 (Duties and Liabilities of Personal Representative)
facts.quote: If the decedent received Medi-Cal assistance, you must notify the State Director of Health Services within 90 days after appointment.

facts.claim_en: In California, the personal representative must keep estate money and property separate from everyone else's, including their own.
facts.claim_es: En California, el representante personal debe mantener el dinero y los bienes de la herencia separados de los de cualquier otra persona, incluidos los suyos.
facts.source_name: Judicial Council of California, form DE-147 (Duties and Liabilities of Personal Representative)
facts.quote: You must keep the money and property in this estate separate from anyone else's, including your own.

facts.claim_en: In Pennsylvania, every personal representative files a verified inventory with the register of wills, covering all estate property except real estate outside Pennsylvania.
facts.claim_es: En Pensilvania, todo representante personal presenta ante el registro de testamentos un inventario verificado de todos los bienes, salvo inmuebles fuera de Pensilvania.
facts.quote: Every personal representative shall file with the register a verified inventory of all real and personal estate of the decedent, except real estate outside of this Commonwealth.

facts.claim_en: In Pennsylvania, if an interested party asks in writing for an earlier inventory, it must be filed within three months after the request.
facts.claim_es: En Pensilvania, si una parte interesada pide por escrito un inventario antes, debe presentarse dentro de tres meses después de la solicitud.
facts.quote: in which event an inventory shall be filed within three months after

facts.claim_en: In Pennsylvania, property found after the inventory goes on a supplemental inventory filed within 30 days of its discovery.
facts.claim_es: En Pensilvania, los bienes encontrados después del inventario se incluyen en un inventario suplementario presentado dentro de 30 días de descubrirse.
facts.quote: he shall file, within 30 days of its discovery, a supplemental inventory thereof with the register

facts.claim_en: In Texas, the personal representative must file the inventory before the 91st day after qualifying, unless the court allows longer.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, el representante personal debe presentar el inventario antes del día 91 después de habilitarse, salvo que el tribunal dé más tiempo.

facts.claim_en: In Texas, the personal representative must notify will beneficiaries no later than the 60th day after the will is admitted to probate.
